name: gemini-observatory-v1
description: Thirty-one theorem tasks for measured Gemini research runs.
gold_labels: The statements are intended as true claims; every run must archive its own audit evidence and human review remains the evaluation authority.

cases.title: Consecutive product is even
cases.statement: For every integer n, n(n+1) is divisible by 2.

cases.title: Cubic difference is divisible by six
cases.statement: For every integer n, n^3 - n is divisible by 6.

cases.title: Sum of the first integers
cases.statement: For every natural number n, 1 + 2 + ... + n = n(n+1)/2.

cases.title: Sum of squares
cases.statement: For every natural number n, 1^2 + 2^2 + ... + n^2 = n(n+1)(2n+1)/6.

cases.title: Sum of cubes
cases.statement: For every natural number n, 1^3 + 2^3 + ... + n^3 = (n(n+1)/2)^2.

cases.title: Consecutive integers are coprime
cases.statement: For every integer n, gcd(n,n+1)=1.

cases.title: Even square implies even base
cases.statement: For every integer n, if n^2 is even then n is even.

cases.title: Odd square implies odd base
cases.statement: For every integer n, if n^2 is odd then n is odd.

cases.title: Divisibility is transitive
cases.statement: For all integers a,b,c, if a divides b and b divides c, then a divides c.

cases.title: Finite geometric sum
cases.statement: For every real number r != 1 and natural n, 1+r+...+r^n=(r^(n+1)-1)/(r-1).

cases.title: Square expansion
cases.statement: For all real numbers a and b, (a+b)^2=a^2+2ab+b^2.

cases.title: Prime residue outside three
cases.statement: Every prime p greater than 3 has the form 6k+1 or 6k-1 for some integer k.

cases.title: Infinitely many primes
cases.statement: There are infinitely many prime numbers.

cases.title: Square root of two
cases.statement: The real number sqrt(2) is irrational.

cases.title: Square root of a prime
cases.statement: For every prime p, sqrt(p) is irrational.

cases.title: Two-variable arithmetic-geometric mean
cases.statement: For positive real numbers a and b, (a+b)/2 is at least sqrt(ab), with equality exactly when a=b.

cases.title: Finite pigeonhole principle
cases.statement: If n+1 objects are placed into n boxes, at least one box contains at least two objects.

cases.title: Graph handshake lemma
cases.statement: In every finite undirected graph, the sum of the vertex degrees equals twice the number of edges.

cases.title: Edges of a finite tree
cases.statement: Every finite connected acyclic graph with n vertices has exactly n-1 edges.

cases.title: Euler relation for connected planar graphs
cases.statement: For every connected planar embedding with V vertices, E edges, and F faces, V-E+F=2.

cases.title: Determinant of a transpose
cases.statement: For every square matrix A over a commutative field, det(A^T)=det(A).

cases.title: Determinant of a product
cases.statement: For all square matrices A and B of the same size over a commutative field, det(AB)=det(A)det(B).

cases.title: Rank-nullity theorem
cases.statement: For every linear map T from a finite-dimensional vector space V to W, dim(V)=rank(T)+dim(kernel(T)).

cases.title: Roots of a nonzero polynomial
cases.statement: A nonzero polynomial over a field of degree d has at most d distinct roots.

cases.title: Derivative of a power
cases.statement: For every nonnegative integer n, the derivative of x^n is n x^(n-1), with the constant case interpreted as zero.

cases.title: Integral of a power
cases.statement: For every integer n not equal to -1, an antiderivative of x^n on a positive interval is x^(n+1)/(n+1).

cases.title: Consecutive Fibonacci numbers
cases.statement: For every n, consecutive Fibonacci numbers F_n and F_(n+1) are coprime.

cases.title: Fibonacci addition identity
cases.statement: For all natural m,n, F_(m+n)=F_(m-1)F_n+F_m F_(n+1) whenever m is positive.

cases.title: Well-ordering descent
cases.statement: Every nonempty set of natural numbers has a least element.

cases.title: Finite injection is a bijection
cases.statement: Every injective function from a finite set to itself is surjective.
